tells.label: garbled text on signs
tells.detail: The signs on the storefronts in frames 3 and 4 contain nonsensical lettering such as 'Ren Trumpe Freoengfrghaue' and 'Pecgniss', which are not real words.

note.text: The AI video exhibits common generation errors such as duplicated buildings in the skyline and garbled text on signs, and does not match authentic 1993 New York footage.  https://x.com/carlos_dnger/status/2097062194189840857  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fT4lDU-QLUY  https://www.opus.pro/blog/ai-slop-aesthetic-12-tells  https://invideo.io/faq/why-do-ai-generated-videos-have-glitches-like-floating/

review.why: The 20.7s frame is a street-level shot with a taxi and pedestrians and no skyline; the box sits on a dark storefront pillar, not on any duplicated skyscrapers
review.label: duplicated buildings in the skyline
